from pathlib import Path
import sys,json
sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1])
from agent.memory import RunLogger
from tools.datasets.state_identifiability import assess_task,state_gaps
from maestro.handoff import RoundRecord,EvidenceLayer,WorldModelLayer,DecisionLayer,ExecutionLayer
import tools.datasets.state_identifiability as checks
import tools.case_memory.workflow as workflow
assert Path(checks.__file__).is_relative_to(Path(sys.argv[1]))
assert Path(workflow.__file__).is_relative_to(Path(sys.argv[1]))
assert not hasattr(checks,'run') and not hasattr(checks,'_lineage')
assert state_gaps(None)==['no_audited_predecision_state']
assert assess_task({'task_id':'fixture','actions':[]})['classification']=='replay_only'
logger=RunLogger(Path.cwd()/'probe_log')
record=RoundRecord('fixture',1,EvidenceLayer(missing_reason=('unknown',)),WorldModelLayer.no_model(),DecisionLayer(),ExecutionLayer())
assert logger.round(record,stage='plan')
assert (logger.root/'rounds/fixture.plan.json').is_file()
assert not any(n=='research' or n.startswith('research.') for n in sys.modules)
print(json.dumps({'installed_paths_verified':True,'pure_evidence_checks':True,'logger_round_write':True,'research_loaded':False}))
